answers.question: Did the agent stay on the shift offer without inventing other topics as facts?
answers.quote: Thanks for asking, but I'm here to tell you about this shift. Would you like to take the wound care shift on Monday from 7:51 pm to 3:51 am in Jersey City, paying 40 dollars an hour?

answers.question: Did the agent close politely when the nurse had to go?
answers.quote: No problem, thanks for your time! Have a great day and talk to you later!
